limitations: Static references establish a lower bound on dependencies, not exhaustive runtime reachability. No reference hit is not evidence of unused or safe-to-delete assets.

Active XML counts enumerate declared file attributes before runtime pruning/randomization. Missing declarations are confined to absent i2rt_yam/flexible_gripper robot packages; composition prunes YAM/default resources before resolving remaining files. This report does not execute or certify each pruned task scene.

Dynamic variant selection, category filters, procedural geometry, environment root overrides, external callers and saved historical datasets are not closed. Pattern match counts describe installed candidates, not executed selections.

Manifest keys remain object-relative where explicitly named object_relative_key; all normalized path fields are repository-relative POSIX. Source/source_collection labels and XML file attribute examples retain original spelling.
Experimental and auxiliary records are separated from production consumers. Unshared outputs and extra files retain unknown reproducibility/historical importance; no deletion inference.

Most calibrated inputs/outputs are checked for file existence only. Content hashing is limited to evidence files, small named nested outputs, declared bottle/texture hashes, and the separate complete mug-directory comparison. Geometry hash names are not file SHA-256.
Saved scene resource fingerprints include paths as well as content hashes. Preserving bytes while moving assets can still invalidate restores; no historical dataset availability is asserted.

methods.calibration: JSON mappings parsed according to runtime loaders: collision meshes/models/parts; measurement source_meshes and original/piece volumes; props variants->geometry->meshes and inertial; marker object-relative values rebased into collision runtime replacements.
methods.explicit_source_paths: Conservative AST path-division resolution with _ASSETS_DIR, visual_details source, asset_root(objects), and _texture_root known bases; unresolved/dynamic expressions are not treated as missing files.
methods.inventory: Path.iterdir immediate roots, Path.rglob(*) regular-file inventory (is_file); deterministic lexical sorting; management overlay excluded.
methods.path_set_digest: For sorted unique repository-relative POSIX file paths in Unicode lexical order, concatenate each UTF-8 path followed by LF, then SHA-256. Empty set hashes empty bytes. This is an identity of the path set, not a content fingerprint. Missing paths are listed explicitly.
methods.runtime_sources: Python AST literals matched existing root/path prefixes or exact root operands in path division; package declarations in assets.py included. Nested mug/plate operands and task-ID registry false positives removed. Evidence is compacted by root and source line; it is not full symbolic execution.
methods.xml: ElementTree walks all file attributes. Active templates resolve under assets/objects using composition._resolve_assets rules, stripping historical assets/ compiler/file prefixes. Legacy files resolve compiler directories from their original assets/scenes parent, not current archival parent. Includes are not recursively expanded.
